arrival_options.label: Pisa airport
arrival_options.tip: From Pisa: the PisaMover shuttle to Pisa Centrale (about 5 minutes), then a regional train to Santa Maria Novella (50 to 75 minutes). About €16 for both. A taxi all the way costs €170 or more.

arrival_options.label: Bologna airport
arrival_options.tip: From Bologna: the Marconi Express shuttle to Bologna Centrale (about 7 minutes, €11), then a high-speed train to Firenze (about 35 minutes; book ahead for the best fare).

arrival_options.label: Train to Santa Maria Novella
arrival_options.tip: Santa Maria Novella station has a 24-hour taxi rank out front.
